issues.detail: The source lists multiple material verification conclusions; the candidate retained only the first.
event_stage describes scope rather than a stage action; reason covers the safety-expense change but omits the separate hedging-accounting rationale.
The total includes both credit and asset impairment losses and several disclosed causes; only one type and one cause were retained.
The model expanded the abbreviated source name into a full legal name that did not occur contiguously with 17% equity.
Pending shareholder approval belongs to approval_status, not uncertainty; old_auditor evidence omitted the auditor name and was locally rejected.
This is a top-shareholder supporting disclosure for an earlier buyback resolution, not the buyback plan announcement itself.
